moscow35-uc44fc508daef5c560a-1.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-u0cfa85e4f386db246b-1.text: For the purpose of implementing Law of the City of Moscow of 05.09.2001 No. 38 “On Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow”:
moscow35-u0cfa85e4f386db246b-1.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-ubb3a3549d8ad823061-1.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-udfec2fd96edbfc5c5a-1.text: - the Regulations on the distinctions “For Services to Moscow” and “For Impeccable Service to the City of Moscow”;
moscow35-udfec2fd96edbfc5c5a-1.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-uad8136562ba747b41b-1.text: - the Regulations on the Prizes of the City of Moscow;
moscow35-uad8136562ba747b41b-1.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-ueb283464073b45a569-1.text: - the Regulations on the Commendation of the Mayor of Moscow;
moscow35-ueb283464073b45a569-1.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-u84028d2f5c492d02c8-1.text: - the Regulations on professional honorary titles of the City of Moscow;
moscow35-u84028d2f5c492d02c8-1.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-ubff3c96d5bc9d43e2b-1.text: - the descriptions of the distinctions “For Services to Moscow” and “For Impeccable Service to the City of Moscow”, the honorary badge of the City of Moscow, the breast badge “Laureate of the Prize of the City of Moscow” and the breast badge accompanying professional honorary titles of the City of Moscow;
moscow35-ubff3c96d5bc9d43e2b-1.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-ud8031b1a8cbb7f82b9-1.text: - the specimens of certificates accompanying the distinctions of the City of Moscow, the Honorary Badge “Honoured Teacher of the City of Moscow”, the Honorary Badge “Honoured Physician of the City of Moscow”, the Honorary Badge “Honoured Industrialist of the City of Moscow” and honorary titles of the City of Moscow, and the forms of the Commendation of the Mayor of Moscow and the diploma accompanying the Prizes of the City of Moscow;
moscow35-ud8031b1a8cbb7f82b9-1.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-u8610214a15a107cc1f-1.text: - the award nomination form for nomination for awards and conferment of professional honorary titles of the City of Moscow;
moscow35-u8610214a15a107cc1f-1.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-u2eb840b66f090e897b-1.text: - the Instructions on the Procedure for Granting Awards and Conferring Professional Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow;
moscow35-u2eb840b66f090e897b-1.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-u7e86385fb11899b5a3-1.text: - the Regulations on the Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow;
moscow35-u7e86385fb11899b5a3-1.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-uc577352c2bcefec286-1.text: - the Regulations on the Honorary Badge “Honoured Teacher of the City of Moscow”;
moscow35-uc577352c2bcefec286-1.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-u044e79d81792d6ca61-1.text: - the Regulations on the Honorary Badge “Honoured Physician of the City of Moscow”;
moscow35-u044e79d81792d6ca61-1.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-u931593dc86c93ebf7e-1.text: - the Regulations on the Honorary Badge “Honoured Industrialist of the City of Moscow”.
moscow35-u931593dc86c93ebf7e-1.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-u09ac68b511d86420e1-1.text: 2. Establish that the Administrative Affairs Directorate of the Mayor and Government of Moscow, on the basis of requests from the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow, shall arrange for the manufacture and delivery of distinctions, honorary badges, breast badges accompanying prizes and honorary titles of the City of Moscow, certificate forms accompanying distinctions, honorary badges and honorary titles of the City of Moscow, diploma forms for the Prizes of the City of Moscow, forms of the Commendation of the Mayor of Moscow, folders, moulded frames and cases.
moscow35-u09ac68b511d86420e1-1.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-u1248163aee3ea072dc-1.text: 3. Cash awards to citizens who have been awarded a distinction of the City of Moscow or the Honorary Badge “Honoured Industrialist of the City of Moscow”, conferred a professional honorary title of the City of Moscow, awarded the “Legend of the Century” Prize or granted the Commendation of the Mayor of Moscow shall be financed from the budget appropriations allocated to the Administrative Affairs Directorate of the Mayor and Government of Moscow for those purposes by the Law of the City of Moscow on the Budget of the City of Moscow for the relevant financial year and planning period.
moscow35-u1248163aee3ea072dc-1.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-ucf615b8e6614eff509-1.text: 4. The Department of Culture of the City of Moscow, the Department of Health of the City of Moscow, the Department of Education and Science of the City of Moscow, the Department of Sport of the City of Moscow, the Tourism Committee of the City of Moscow, the Department of Regional Security and Combating Corruption of the City of Moscow, the Department of Mass Media and Advertising of the City of Moscow, the Department of Labour and Social Protection of the Population of the City of Moscow and the Department of Urban Planning Policy of the City of Moscow shall pay the Prizes of the City of Moscow in the numbers and amounts established by the Regulations on the Prizes from budget appropriations provided for those purposes by the Law of the City of Moscow on the Budget of the City of Moscow for the relevant financial year and planning period.
moscow35-ucf615b8e6614eff509-1.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-u38b1932b1258a51d7c-1.text: 5. Repealed. — Decree of the Mayor of Moscow of 27.08.2012 No. 52-УМ.
moscow35-u38b1932b1258a51d7c-1.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-u2cc43d0517e4b3442f-1.text: 6. Repeal the legal acts of the Mayor of Moscow in accordance with the list.
moscow35-u2cc43d0517e4b3442f-1.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-ueb023883393fa57901-1.text: 7. Assign oversight of the implementation of this Decree to N.A. Sergunina, Deputy Mayor of Moscow in the Government of Moscow and Head of the Executive Office of the Mayor and Government of Moscow.
moscow35-ueb023883393fa57901-1.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-ub4d534a6ad4f3a4ae5-1.text: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR SERVICES TO MOSCOW”
moscow35-ub4d534a6ad4f3a4ae5-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR SERVICES TO MOSCOW”

moscow35-uf14e6f475f0d57cd04-1.text: The distinction “For Services to Moscow” shall be awarded:
moscow35-uf14e6f475f0d57cd04-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR SERVICES TO MOSCOW”

moscow35-ub7e0ecb06d64ba2308-1.text: - for major personal achievements in state, scientific, creative, industrial and other activities and for carrying out specific activities beneficial to the city that contribute to Moscow’s socioeconomic, scientific, technological and cultural development and improve the living standards of its residents;
moscow35-ub7e0ecb06d64ba2308-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR SERVICES TO MOSCOW”

moscow35-uec5bf13d959637e4ec-1.text: - for a substantial contribution to strengthening friendship and cooperation among nations and ethnic groups, fruitful activities to bring their cultures closer together and mutually enrich them, and active assistance in developing mutually beneficial cooperation with constituent entities of the Russian Federation and friendly relations with foreign states;
moscow35-uec5bf13d959637e4ec-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR SERVICES TO MOSCOW”

moscow35-u4a2d0b8da4befb0247-1.text: - for multifaceted charitable activities in the interests of the city and Muscovites.
moscow35-u4a2d0b8da4befb0247-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR SERVICES TO MOSCOW”

moscow35-u913986734ccf694fc1-1.text: Persons nominated for the distinction “For Services to Moscow” shall, as a rule, have received awards or honorary titles of the City of Moscow or have been awarded state awards of the Russian Federation or the USSR for services to Moscow.
moscow35-u913986734ccf694fc1-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR SERVICES TO MOSCOW”

moscow35-u5d5c7896fd248961f8-1.text: Persons awarded the distinction “For Services to Moscow” shall receive a cash award in an amount established by the Government of Moscow. The cash award shall be paid by the Administrative Affairs Directorate of the Mayor and Government of Moscow.
moscow35-u5d5c7896fd248961f8-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR SERVICES TO MOSCOW”

moscow35-uf69aaa661b23a8f606-1.text: The distinction “For Services to Moscow” shall not be awarded more than once to the same person.
moscow35-uf69aaa661b23a8f606-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR SERVICES TO MOSCOW”

moscow35-u848e485b19cc286ac7-1.text: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR IMPECCABLE SERVICE TO THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
moscow35-u848e485b19cc286ac7-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR IMPECCABLE SERVICE TO THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-u33cf9881abffa7c8dd-1.text: The distinction “For Impeccable Service to the City of Moscow” shall be awarded for a specific contribution to Moscow’s development and many years of fruitful activity aimed at the prosperity of the city and improvement of the well-being of Muscovites.
moscow35-u33cf9881abffa7c8dd-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR IMPECCABLE SERVICE TO THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-u356860c0076d063920-1.text: Where they have rendered meritorious service, persons who have worked impeccably in organizations and institutions of the City of Moscow for 20, 25, 30, 40 or 50 years respectively and have received awards or honorary titles of the City of Moscow, or have been awarded state awards of the Russian Federation or the USSR or departmental distinctions for labour for services to Moscow, shall be nominated for the distinction “For Impeccable Service to the City of Moscow”.
moscow35-u356860c0076d063920-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR IMPECCABLE SERVICE TO THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-u81896c96bffda8e06c-1.text: Persons awarded the distinction “For Impeccable Service to the City of Moscow” shall receive a cash award in an amount established by the Government of Moscow. The cash award shall be paid by the Administrative Affairs Directorate of the Mayor and Government of Moscow.
moscow35-u81896c96bffda8e06c-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR IMPECCABLE SERVICE TO THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-uad41f7ebd4efbe230f-1.text: 1. The Prize of the City of Moscow in Literature and the Arts (hereinafter, the Prize) shall be awarded for the creation of the most talented literary and artistic works distinguished by novelty and originality that have received public recognition and contribute to the development of literature and the arts in the City of Moscow.
moscow35-uad41f7ebd4efbe230f-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS

moscow35-udc4ef617328c8a7857-1.text: 3. Literary and artistic works and other projects shall be submitted for the Prize to the Department of Culture of the City of Moscow by institutions, creative unions and the collectives of creative organizations and associations.
moscow35-udc4ef617328c8a7857-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS

moscow35-u050a645fc0b9c8f6b4-1.text: The Department of Culture of the City of Moscow shall accept projects and works submitted for the Prize annually from 01.12 of the preceding year to 01.03 of the current year, provided that they were made public at least one year before the closing date for submissions.
moscow35-u050a645fc0b9c8f6b4-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS

moscow35-ua1a56dd6033dc9446a-1.text: 4. The Prize may be awarded to an author or a team of authors for creating a joint project or work.
moscow35-ua1a56dd6033dc9446a-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS

moscow35-ub91b71569eab82b4cd-1.text: The Prize need not be awarded in individual categories.
moscow35-ub91b71569eab82b4cd-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS

moscow35-uef5b3e04ceae2fb556-1.text: Two or more Prizes may be awarded in one category.
moscow35-uef5b3e04ceae2fb556-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS

moscow35-u82114d182d5c04f1e3-1.text: In the categories “visual arts”, “music”, “theatre” and “circus and variety arts”, one Prize may be awarded to several nominees for works in different areas.
moscow35-u82114d182d5c04f1e3-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS

moscow35-u00f7977ac12f33510f-1.text: The same author may not be nominated simultaneously for the Prize for two or more works or projects.
moscow35-u00f7977ac12f33510f-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS

moscow35-u63c86193e686243f99-1.text: 5. A team nominated for the Prize must include only those authors whose contribution to the creation of the project or work was decisive.
moscow35-u63c86193e686243f99-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS

moscow35-uc62a427b517f19ca29-1.text: A team of authors must not comprise more than five persons.
moscow35-uc62a427b517f19ca29-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS

moscow35-u32352eb6c48623e46e-1.text: 6. Works and projects, and teams nominated for the Prize, shall not be considered if they have been nominated for other prizes or other awards.
moscow35-u32352eb6c48623e46e-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS

moscow35-uc0f71812e48f9203c8-1.text: 7. Literary works may be nominated for the Prize only after publication, and artistic works only after they have been presented to a broad public at concerts, exhibitions, theatres or cinemas, in the press or on television.
moscow35-uc0f71812e48f9203c8-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS

moscow35-u350c5cafe6812d3bad-1.text: Projects and works nominated for the Prize shall be discussed in creative and public organizations and the mass media, as organized by the Department of Culture of the City of Moscow. Materials from the discussions shall be sent to the Department of Culture of the City of Moscow.
moscow35-u350c5cafe6812d3bad-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS

moscow35-uc43599458dd4a7def2-1.text: 8. Works and projects submitted for the Prize shall be considered by the Commission for the Prizes of the City of Moscow in Literature and the Arts (hereinafter, the Commission). The Regulations on the Commission shall be approved by the Mayor of Moscow. The Commission’s membership shall be approved by a legal act of the Department of Culture of the City of Moscow.
moscow35-uc43599458dd4a7def2-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS

moscow35-u0b147feed43c4b8432-1.text: After discussing the works and projects nominated for the Prize, the Commission shall adopt at its meetings a decision recommending the award of the current year’s Prizes, by an open vote and a majority of those present.
moscow35-u0b147feed43c4b8432-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS

moscow35-u294c082e82202d947e-1.text: Where works or projects authored by members of the Commission are submitted for the Prize, those members shall be temporarily excluded from its work.
moscow35-u294c082e82202d947e-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS

moscow35-ua13d6449e38e7ee729-1.text: 9. On the basis of the Commission’s proposals, a Decree of the Mayor of Moscow on awarding the Prizes shall be issued.
moscow35-ua13d6449e38e7ee729-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS

moscow35-u815931e89a4b6e359c-1.text: 10. The Prizes shall be paid by the Department of Culture of the City of Moscow on the basis of the Decree of the Mayor of Moscow on awarding the Prizes.
moscow35-u815931e89a4b6e359c-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS

moscow35-ub82c1874ea165a3066-1.text: 11. Where the Prize is awarded to a team of authors, its monetary component shall be divided equally among them.
moscow35-ub82c1874ea165a3066-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS

moscow35-u6e183e7bcbca45dc32-1.text: 12. A laureate may receive the Prize again for new major achievements in literature and the arts.
moscow35-u6e183e7bcbca45dc32-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS

moscow35-u4bed7e0b0eb8a801ea-1.text: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE
moscow35-u4bed7e0b0eb8a801ea-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE

moscow35-u9ffef11b89bc0d6fa3-1.text: 1. The Prize of the City of Moscow in Medicine (hereinafter, the Prize) shall be awarded for the most effective work of physicians, medical scientists and healthcare organizers, distinguished by novelty, originality and reliability, that contributes to the development of practical healthcare and medical science in the City of Moscow and has received public recognition.
moscow35-u9ffef11b89bc0d6fa3-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE

moscow35-u10bbf2ea9c14b24aac-1.text: 2. Up to 6 Prizes, each of 3000 thousand roubles, shall be awarded annually on the eve of Medical Workers’ Day.
moscow35-u10bbf2ea9c14b24aac-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE

moscow35-u2f5fc80c16c1a2b2ee-1.text: 3. Works shall be submitted for the Prize to the Department of Health of the City of Moscow by medical treatment and preventive care institutions, state medical enterprises, Moscow associations of physicians and nurses and other organizations.
moscow35-u2f5fc80c16c1a2b2ee-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE

moscow35-u1552c00b4032a0d238-1.text: Works shall be accepted by the Department of Health of the City of Moscow annually until 15.01, provided that they were made public at least one year before the closing date for submissions.
moscow35-u1552c00b4032a0d238-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE

moscow35-u5f4fbbddbc84500c6e-1.text: 4. The same author may not be nominated simultaneously for the Prize for two or more works.
moscow35-u5f4fbbddbc84500c6e-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE

moscow35-uf76089f729f2087591-1.text: 5. A team nominated for the Prize must include only those authors whose contribution to the work was decisive.
moscow35-uf76089f729f2087591-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE

moscow35-u41a6c8639ece51c829-1.text: A team of authors must not comprise more than ten persons.
moscow35-u41a6c8639ece51c829-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE

moscow35-u4d80ca4c983d5a88a0-1.text: 6. Works and teams nominated for the Prize shall not be considered if they have been nominated for other prizes or other awards.
moscow35-u4d80ca4c983d5a88a0-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE

moscow35-u50a7015dc169837cd3-1.text: 7. Works in medicine may be nominated for the Prize only after publication, clinical trials and implementation in the city’s practical healthcare.
moscow35-u50a7015dc169837cd3-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE

moscow35-udd0273f30b34086438-1.text: Works nominated for the Prize shall be discussed among medical staff collectives, public organizations and the mass media. Materials from the discussions shall be sent to the Department of Health of the City of Moscow.
moscow35-udd0273f30b34086438-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE

moscow35-u38baef4f884e4e34a5-1.text: 8. Works submitted for the Prize shall be considered by the expert council for awarding the Prize (hereinafter, the expert council) attached to the Department of Health of the City of Moscow.
moscow35-u38baef4f884e4e34a5-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE

moscow35-u66ee251b10b1b01740-1.text: After discussing the works nominated for the Prize, the expert council shall adopt at its meetings a decision recommending the award of the current year’s Prizes, by an open vote and a majority of those present.
moscow35-u66ee251b10b1b01740-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE

moscow35-u2fd31b64a0c41dacc1-1.text: Where works authored by members of the expert council are submitted for the Prize, those members shall be temporarily excluded from its work.
moscow35-u2fd31b64a0c41dacc1-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE

moscow35-ue9672b16fa66c22e5a-1.text: 9. The works selected by the expert council shall be forwarded by the Department of Health of the City of Moscow to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow for subsequent consideration by the Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow.
moscow35-ue9672b16fa66c22e5a-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE

moscow35-u9630a97d9ebeae69eb-1.text: 10. On the basis of proposals from the Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow, a Decree of the Mayor of Moscow on awarding the Prizes shall be issued.
moscow35-u9630a97d9ebeae69eb-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE

moscow35-uf4095b191678dc6105-1.text: 11. The Prizes shall be paid by the Department of Health of the City of Moscow on the basis of the Decree of the Mayor of Moscow on awarding the Prizes.
moscow35-uf4095b191678dc6105-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE

moscow35-ue7857037b780116822-1.text: 12. Where the Prize is awarded to a team of authors, its monetary component shall be divided equally among them.
moscow35-ue7857037b780116822-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE

moscow35-u4e041d412e28962dbb-1.text: 13. A laureate may receive the Prize again for new major achievements in medicine.
moscow35-u4e041d412e28962dbb-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE

moscow35-u1ae3e80cc34aa21929-1.text: 3. Materials and works shall be submitted for the Prize to the Department of Education and Science of the City of Moscow by meetings of the staff collectives of educational organizations.
moscow35-u1ae3e80cc34aa21929-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN EDUCATION

moscow35-ua8badfa3002ca02b12-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN EDUCATION

moscow35-u3f338dd3f245d5eeef-1.text: 4. The same candidate may not be nominated simultaneously for the Prize for two or more works.
moscow35-u3f338dd3f245d5eeef-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN EDUCATION

moscow35-u129fe8378a842bcd14-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN EDUCATION

moscow35-u46ad5f999aceb9df71-1.text: 8. Materials and works submitted for the Prize shall be considered by the expert council for awarding the Prize (hereinafter, the expert council) attached to the Department of Education and Science of the City of Moscow.
moscow35-u46ad5f999aceb9df71-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN EDUCATION

moscow35-uf376057ed8765314e6-1.text: After discussing the materials and works nominated for the Prize, the expert council shall adopt at its meeting a decision recommending the award of the current year’s Prizes, by an open vote and a majority of those present.

moscow35-u986f5522d68db5653d-1.text: 9. The materials and works selected by the expert council shall be forwarded by the Department of Education and Science of the City of Moscow to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow for subsequent consideration by the Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow.
moscow35-u986f5522d68db5653d-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN EDUCATION

moscow35-u9630a97d9ebeae69eb-2.text: 10. On the basis of proposals from the Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow, a Decree of the Mayor of Moscow on awarding the Prizes shall be issued.
moscow35-u9630a97d9ebeae69eb-2.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN EDUCATION

moscow35-ua23730964ee3b1e496-1.locator: ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN PHYSICAL CULTURE AND SPORT

moscow35-u32c34053a4d743a640-1.text: 1. The Prize of the City of Moscow in Physical Culture and Sport (hereinafter, the Prize) shall be awarded for the most significant activities and works aimed at improving citizens’ health and organizing active recreation, developing their desire for physical improvement and harmonious personal development, involving children and young people in regular sports activities, and developing and introducing promising methods into the system of physical education of citizens.
moscow35-u32c34053a4d743a640-1.locator: ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN PHYSICAL CULTURE AND SPORT

moscow35-u458e3a3f08e9546c70-1.text: 2. Up to 15 Prizes, each of 1000 thousand roubles, shall be awarded annually on the eve of Physical Culture Day.
moscow35-u458e3a3f08e9546c70-1.locator: ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN PHYSICAL CULTURE AND SPORT

moscow35-u9e6b4a1e3b6b11ed12-1.text: 3. Materials and works shall be submitted for the Prize to the Department of Sport of the City of Moscow by state authorities, local self-government bodies and organizations.

moscow35-u5f67db97f66c94a4b5-1.text: REGULATIONS ON THE “LEGEND OF THE CENTURY” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
moscow35-u5f67db97f66c94a4b5-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “LEGEND OF THE CENTURY” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u6e6ad8176599eb98f6-1.text: 1. The “Legend of the Century” Prize of the City of Moscow (hereinafter, the Prize) shall be awarded to citizens of the Russian Federation who are statespersons, public figures, workers in science and culture or representatives of other fields and who, over many decades of creative activity in the XX century, achieved unique, internationally recognized results of the highest professional standard and made an outstanding contribution to the political, socioeconomic, scientific, technological and cultural development of the City of Moscow.
moscow35-u6e6ad8176599eb98f6-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “LEGEND OF THE CENTURY” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u422b20ebe4efc09491-1.text: 2. No more than 3 Prizes, each of 1500 thousand roubles, shall be awarded annually.
moscow35-u422b20ebe4efc09491-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “LEGEND OF THE CENTURY” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u142368568607e4281f-1.text: 3. Candidates nominated for the Prize shall be considered by the commission for awarding the Prize (hereinafter, the commission), established by the Mayor of Moscow.
moscow35-u142368568607e4281f-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “LEGEND OF THE CENTURY” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u3ee9884af07ac13ce7-1.text: 4. Candidates shall be nominated for the Prize to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow by collectives of organizations, creative unions and public associations, state authorities and local self-government bodies, and structural subdivisions of the Government of Moscow.
moscow35-u3ee9884af07ac13ce7-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “LEGEND OF THE CENTURY” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u66e672207e22eced75-1.text: 5. A candidate nominated for the Prize shall not be considered if nominated for other prizes or other awards.
moscow35-u66e672207e22eced75-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “LEGEND OF THE CENTURY” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u2dcc313fd1980afc23-1.text: Candidates shall not be nominated for the Prize posthumously.
moscow35-u2dcc313fd1980afc23-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “LEGEND OF THE CENTURY” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u5ad121ea1369624edf-1.text: 6. Candidates nominated for the Prize shall be discussed in the city’s mass media, as organized by the Press Centre of the Mayor and Government of Moscow. The results of the discussions shall be sent to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow.
moscow35-u5ad121ea1369624edf-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “LEGEND OF THE CENTURY” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u57ec753a89af44685d-1.text: 7. After discussing the candidates nominated for the Prize, the commission shall adopt at its meetings a decision on awarding the current year’s Prize, by an open vote and a majority of those present.
moscow35-u57ec753a89af44685d-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “LEGEND OF THE CENTURY” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-ud34425ee9506c17efc-1.text: 8. On the basis of proposals from the Commission for Awarding the Prize, a Decree of the Mayor of Moscow on awarding the Prize shall be issued.
moscow35-ud34425ee9506c17efc-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “LEGEND OF THE CENTURY” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u0d1352a99df19745ea-1.text: 9. The Prize shall be paid by the Administrative Affairs Directorate of the Mayor and Government of Moscow on the basis of the Decree of the Mayor of Moscow on awarding the Prize.
moscow35-u0d1352a99df19745ea-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “LEGEND OF THE CENTURY” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u5fbad9965b6a1fd46c-1.text: 10. A laureate shall not be nominated for the Prize again.
moscow35-u5fbad9965b6a1fd46c-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “LEGEND OF THE CENTURY” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u246b0002103a8355b0-1.text: 11. Laureates shall be invited by the Government of Moscow to events marking state holidays, City Day and other important occasions.
moscow35-u246b0002103a8355b0-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “LEGEND OF THE CENTURY” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u3d47569c806a57cf29-1.text: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY
moscow35-u3d47569c806a57cf29-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY

moscow35-u17556e5898519e4365-1.text: 1. The Prize of the City of Moscow in Ensuring Security (hereinafter, the Prize) shall be awarded for a significant contribution to ensuring the city’s comprehensive security and for creating scientific developments and technologies whose implementation has substantially improved the city’s security.
moscow35-u17556e5898519e4365-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY

moscow35-ud733c1fab6b1423420-1.text: 2. Up to 15 Prizes, each of 1000 thousand roubles, shall be awarded annually on the eve of City Day.
moscow35-ud733c1fab6b1423420-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY

moscow35-u4ba5ac9ef6a286ca20-1.text: 3. Materials and works shall be submitted for the Prize by collectives of organizations to the Department of Regional Security and Combating Corruption of the City of Moscow (hereinafter, the Department).
moscow35-u4ba5ac9ef6a286ca20-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY

moscow35-u2f993173ff2c8117f1-1.text: Materials and works shall be accepted by the Department annually from 15.01 to 15.04 of the current year.
moscow35-u2f993173ff2c8117f1-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY

moscow35-u7bd6cda06825f5812d-1.text: 4. The Prize may be awarded to individuals or to a group of persons (team) for producing a joint work.
moscow35-u7bd6cda06825f5812d-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY

moscow35-ud4df7667d42dee578e-1.text: The same candidate or team may not be nominated simultaneously for the Prize for two or more works.
moscow35-ud4df7667d42dee578e-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY

moscow35-uff56180858ff1f6898-1.text: 5. A team nominated for the Prize must include only those persons whose contribution to the work was decisive.
moscow35-uff56180858ff1f6898-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY

moscow35-u27b137b845c73ced2b-1.text: The team must not comprise more than ten persons.
moscow35-u27b137b845c73ced2b-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY

moscow35-u6cb994fe773965284d-2.text: 6. Materials and works submitted for the Prize shall not be considered if they have been nominated for other prizes or the candidates have been nominated for other awards.
moscow35-u6cb994fe773965284d-2.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY

moscow35-u1c94737a16a3440b5a-1.text: 7. Materials and works may be nominated for the Prize only after implementation in practice.
moscow35-u1c94737a16a3440b5a-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY

moscow35-u54fedbc081ada3dfd5-1.text: 8. Materials and works submitted for the Prize shall be considered by the expert council for awarding the Prize attached to the Department (hereinafter, the expert council).
moscow35-u54fedbc081ada3dfd5-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY

moscow35-ue62098ca804bc3c5fe-1.text: Where materials or works authored by members of the expert council are submitted for the Prize, those members shall be temporarily excluded from its work.
moscow35-ue62098ca804bc3c5fe-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY

moscow35-u26bfb16468bb25c96a-1.text: 9. The materials and works selected by the expert council shall be forwarded to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow for subsequent submission to the Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow (hereinafter, the Commission).
moscow35-u26bfb16468bb25c96a-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY

moscow35-u5ba5630c30e62d60ed-1.text: 10. On the basis of the Commission’s proposals, a Decree of the Mayor of Moscow on awarding the Prizes shall be issued.
moscow35-u5ba5630c30e62d60ed-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY

moscow35-uabeb091f06b2405c37-1.text: 11. The Prizes shall be paid by the Department on the basis of the Decree of the Mayor of Moscow on awarding the Prize.
moscow35-uabeb091f06b2405c37-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY

moscow35-u31a2b2430e0923a8e8-1.text: Where the Prize is awarded to a team, its monetary component shall be divided equally among the team members.
moscow35-u31a2b2430e0923a8e8-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY

moscow35-u1bb4ab37297437219b-1.text: 12. The Prize shall not be awarded more than once to the same recipient.
moscow35-u1bb4ab37297437219b-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY

moscow35-u997eba47986c5ff302-1.text: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING
moscow35-u997eba47986c5ff302-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING

moscow35-u7423efd38ee4d520a2-1.text: 1. The Prize of the City of Moscow in Architecture and Urban Planning (hereinafter, the Prize) shall be awarded for developing the most expressive, original and high-quality architectural and urban planning designs for capital construction projects whose implementation will address the tasks of creating a comfortable urban environment and contribute to the future development of the construction industry in the City of Moscow.
moscow35-u7423efd38ee4d520a2-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING

moscow35-u4a7aeff698bd7cb686-1.text: 2. Up to 12 Prizes, each of 1000 thousand roubles, shall be awarded annually on the eve of Architects’ Day.
moscow35-u4a7aeff698bd7cb686-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING

moscow35-ue33261066e7b334c8a-1.text: 3. Architectural and urban planning designs for capital construction projects shall be submitted for the Prize by organizations, public associations, creative unions, authors or teams of authors of architectural and urban planning designs by filing an application for the Prize with the Department of Urban Planning Policy of the City of Moscow, specifying the registration number of the certificate approving the architectural and urban planning design for the capital construction project submitted for the Prize.
moscow35-ue33261066e7b334c8a-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING

moscow35-u862ecd1b767c021837-1.text: Applications for the Prize shall be accepted by the Department of Urban Planning Policy of the City of Moscow annually from 01.12 of the year preceding the award year until 15.02 of the current year in which the Prize is to be awarded.
moscow35-u862ecd1b767c021837-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING

moscow35-ua47c690b60c9c25030-1.text: 4. Materials of an architectural and urban planning design for a capital construction project (hereinafter, architectural and urban planning design materials) may be nominated for the Prize if they received a certificate approving the architectural and urban planning design for the capital construction project (hereinafter, the certificate) between 01.01 and 31.12 of the year preceding the award year.
moscow35-ua47c690b60c9c25030-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING

moscow35-u1eac56b230aeb69971-1.text: 5. The Prize may be awarded to an author or a team of authors for developing the most expressive, original and high-quality architectural and urban planning design (jointly developing architectural and urban planning design materials).
moscow35-u1eac56b230aeb69971-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING

moscow35-u8151c2ce5510943b7c-1.text: A team of authors whose architectural and urban planning design materials have been nominated for the Prize must include only those authors named in the certificate whose contribution to the work was decisive.
moscow35-u8151c2ce5510943b7c-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING

moscow35-u8cf8d8cdfddb0f9f4d-1.text: A team of authors may not comprise more than three persons.
moscow35-u8cf8d8cdfddb0f9f4d-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING

moscow35-ubf83351f88c6f9fbb4-1.text: 6. The same author (team of authors) may be nominated simultaneously for the Prize for two or more capital construction projects.
moscow35-ubf83351f88c6f9fbb4-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING

moscow35-uae129c843a6668ecbc-1.text: The Prize may not be awarded in the current year to the same author (team of authors) for two or more capital construction projects.
moscow35-uae129c843a6668ecbc-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING

moscow35-u35f685d31233b9ed2f-1.text: 7. Architectural and urban planning design materials nominated for the Prize shall be considered by the expert council for awarding the Prize attached to the Department of Urban Planning Policy of the City of Moscow (hereinafter, the expert council).
moscow35-u35f685d31233b9ed2f-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING

moscow35-u4f34ca700f38988921-1.text: 8. The Regulations on the expert council, the procedure for considering architectural and urban planning design materials nominated for the Prize and the criteria for their evaluation shall be established by a legal act of the Department of Urban Planning Policy of the City of Moscow.
moscow35-u4f34ca700f38988921-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING

moscow35-u71a81e341a0a2c5297-1.text: 9. Where the expert council considers architectural and urban planning design materials authored by its members, those members shall not take part in the vote.
moscow35-u71a81e341a0a2c5297-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING

moscow35-u37a26012a97dbf824e-1.text: 10. Following consideration of the architectural and urban planning design materials nominated for the Prize, the expert council shall adopt at its meeting a decision recommending the award of the current year’s Prizes.
moscow35-u37a26012a97dbf824e-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING

moscow35-u7b8236c80cc2535ccf-1.text: 11. The architectural and urban planning design materials selected by the expert council shall be forwarded to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow for subsequent submission to the Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow.
moscow35-u7b8236c80cc2535ccf-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING

moscow35-u7d3b3966cee2f03435-1.text: On the basis of proposals from the Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow, a Decree of the Mayor of Moscow on awarding the Prizes shall be issued.
moscow35-u7d3b3966cee2f03435-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING

moscow35-uc118dd08ff2d809868-1.text: 12. The Prizes shall be paid by the Department of Urban Planning Policy of the City of Moscow on the basis of the Decree of the Mayor of Moscow on awarding the Prizes.
moscow35-uc118dd08ff2d809868-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING

moscow35-ua738f3ce9ace9dfdbe-2.text: 13. Where the Prize is awarded to a team of authors, its monetary component shall be divided equally among them.
moscow35-ua738f3ce9ace9dfdbe-2.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING

moscow35-ueca7815127162a1c4c-1.text: 14. A laureate may receive the Prize again for new major achievements in architecture and urban planning.
moscow35-ueca7815127162a1c4c-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING

moscow35-ude03c710fd9e147cc3-1.text: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
moscow35-ude03c710fd9e147cc3-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-uc7e6ca0ecca1409323-1.text: 1. The “Stork’s Wings” Prize of the City of Moscow (hereinafter, the Prize) shall be awarded for a special contribution to the development of family placement for orphans and children left without parental care in the City of Moscow.
moscow35-uc7e6ca0ecca1409323-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u46ed68da1664d5ad67-1.text: 2. The Prize shall be awarded annually on the eve of World Orphans Day in the following categories:
moscow35-u46ed68da1664d5ad67-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-uc4fa3bbd5c41d6358e-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-ucc09527060159170fe-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-ue3b30e834736b1cb17-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u49de33bf4740a3e9eb-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u0da74b16090c9e9119-1.text: 3. The Prize shall be awarded as follows:
moscow35-u0da74b16090c9e9119-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-uee6c44f6d30cabf9e7-1.text: 3.1. In the “Family of the Year” category: up to three Prizes to adoptive families, families of guardians (curators), foster families or patronage-care families.
moscow35-uee6c44f6d30cabf9e7-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u9d0240e602642981f9-1.text: 3.2. In the “Organization of the Year” category: up to five Prizes to staff collectives of guardianship and curatorship bodies, organizations for orphans and children left without parental care, schools for foster parents, nonprofit organizations and other organizations, and to collectives of public associations that have made a special contribution to the development of family placement for orphans and children left without parental care in the City of Moscow.
moscow35-u9d0240e602642981f9-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u1321637bdd284f6d7d-1.text: 3.3. In the “Person of the Year” category: up to three Prizes to statespersons, political and public figures, figures in science and culture, representatives of the mass media and representatives of other fields who have made a special contribution to the development of family placement for orphans and children left without parental care in the City of Moscow.
moscow35-u1321637bdd284f6d7d-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u339a7b3b3f7c510109-1.text: 3.4. In the “Benefactor of the Year” category: one Prize to persons conducting charitable activities in the field of developing family placement for orphans and children left without parental care in the City of Moscow.
moscow35-u339a7b3b3f7c510109-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u8c1d1db7ad1ec33a77-1.text: 4. The Prize need not be awarded in individual categories.
moscow35-u8c1d1db7ad1ec33a77-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-ue461181a4ee5ae0414-1.text: 5. Materials shall be submitted for the Prize to the Department of Labour and Social Protection of the Population of the City of Moscow by collectives of organizations, public associations and creative unions, and by state authorities and local self-government bodies.
moscow35-ue461181a4ee5ae0414-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u29a078ce9e6bfb93ce-1.text: Materials shall be accepted by the Department of Labour and Social Protection of the Population of the City of Moscow annually from 15.01 to 15.04 of the current year.
moscow35-u29a078ce9e6bfb93ce-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-uac1e2bcbd11ce75581-1.text: 6. Candidates shall not be nominated simultaneously for the Prize in two or more categories.
moscow35-uac1e2bcbd11ce75581-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u583f1a75b38feb633d-1.text: 7. Materials submitted for the Prize shall be considered by the expert council for awarding the Prize attached to the Department of Labour and Social Protection of the Population of the City of Moscow (hereinafter, the expert council).
moscow35-u583f1a75b38feb633d-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u32d7bd6b2c3748e35e-1.text: The regulations and membership of the expert council, the procedure for considering and criteria for evaluating materials submitted for the Prize, and the description of the statuette of the “Stork’s Wings” Prize of the City of Moscow shall be established by a legal act of the Department of Labour and Social Protection of the Population of the City of Moscow.
moscow35-u32d7bd6b2c3748e35e-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u0164945d843c55d1b0-1.text: 8. After discussing the materials nominated for the Prize, the expert council shall adopt at its meetings a decision recommending the award of the current year’s Prizes, by an open vote and a majority of those present.
moscow35-u0164945d843c55d1b0-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u307835f7a6fc5b8507-1.text: Where members of the expert council are nominated for the Prize, they shall be temporarily excluded from its work.
moscow35-u307835f7a6fc5b8507-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-ufb5645cc66329abd69-1.text: 9. The materials selected by the expert council shall be forwarded to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow for subsequent submission to the Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow.
moscow35-ufb5645cc66329abd69-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u7d3b3966cee2f03435-2.text: On the basis of proposals from the Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow, a Decree of the Mayor of Moscow on awarding the Prizes shall be issued.
moscow35-u7d3b3966cee2f03435-2.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-ud365907a6006158575-1.text: 10. In addition to the breast badge “Laureate of the Prize of the City of Moscow” and the diploma of a laureate of the Prize of the City of Moscow, laureates shall be presented with the statuette of the “Stork’s Wings” Prize of the City of Moscow.
moscow35-ud365907a6006158575-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u00acce99e569ff45fd-1.text: 11. Where the Prize is awarded in the “Family of the Year” category, one of the adoptive parents, guardians (curators), foster parents or patronage-care parents in the family shall receive a cash award of 1000 thousand roubles.
moscow35-u00acce99e569ff45fd-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u7b0511daf6345f09ec-1.text: The cash award shall be paid by the Department of Labour and Social Protection of the Population of the City of Moscow on the basis of the Decree of the Mayor of Moscow on awarding the Prizes.
moscow35-u7b0511daf6345f09ec-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-uae7d1cc30c7ae9652c-1.text: 12. A laureate may receive the Prize again for new achievements in developing family placement for orphans and children left without parental care in the City of Moscow.
moscow35-uae7d1cc30c7ae9652c-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-ua8565fc0b8aef80c20-1.text: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM
moscow35-ua8565fc0b8aef80c20-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM

moscow35-u4af1d13f314839e6ab-1.text: 1. The Prize of the City of Moscow in Tourism (hereinafter, the Prize) shall be awarded for the most significant activities and works aimed at developing the tourism potential of the City of Moscow, improving the quality and attractiveness of tourism services and the efficiency of the use of tourism resources, developing tourism infrastructure located in the City of Moscow, implementing new investment projects in tourism and hospitality, introducing best practices and standards in hospitality services, improving forms of tourist and excursion services, creating and promoting new tourism products and services, and introducing digital technologies in tourism and the hospitality industry of the City of Moscow.
moscow35-u4af1d13f314839e6ab-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM

moscow35-u58110c3baa5cd34b44-1.text: 2. Up to 10 Prizes, each of 1000 thousand roubles, shall be awarded annually on the eve of World Tourism Day.
moscow35-u58110c3baa5cd34b44-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM

moscow35-u4545289eadad962483-1.text: 3. Materials and works shall be submitted for the Prize to the Tourism Committee of the City of Moscow by state authorities, local self-government bodies and organizations.
moscow35-u4545289eadad962483-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM

moscow35-ue7f59872128652b67b-1.text: Materials and works submitted for the Prize shall be accepted by the Tourism Committee of the City of Moscow annually until 01.04, provided that they were made public at least one year before the closing date for submissions.
moscow35-ue7f59872128652b67b-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM

moscow35-u49ed63bf224e054d32-2.text: 4. Simultaneous nomination for the Prize for two or more activities and works is not permitted.
moscow35-u49ed63bf224e054d32-2.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM

moscow35-u87e8886e78617017d6-2.text: 5. A team submitting materials and works for the Prize must include only those authors whose contribution to the work was decisive.
moscow35-u87e8886e78617017d6-2.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM

moscow35-u39a76da5a763d5a2a5-2.text: A team of authors may not comprise more than ten persons.
moscow35-u39a76da5a763d5a2a5-2.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM

moscow35-u83fe611dceeccc7533-2.text: 6. Materials and works submitted for the Prize, and teams submitting materials and works for the Prize, shall not be considered if they have been nominated for other prizes or other awards.
moscow35-u83fe611dceeccc7533-2.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM

moscow35-uddade6546f5c6f32c4-1.text: 7. Materials and works may be submitted for the Prize only after publication, broad public discussion and implementation in the practice of tourism and the hospitality industry.
moscow35-uddade6546f5c6f32c4-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM

moscow35-ub976f8519c4a181637-1.text: Those materials and works shall be discussed among the staff collectives of organizations and in the mass media. Materials from the discussions shall be sent to the Tourism Committee of the City of Moscow.
moscow35-ub976f8519c4a181637-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM

moscow35-uef23a54ca02fa71a32-1.text: 8. Materials and works submitted for the Prize shall be considered by the expert council for awarding the Prize (hereinafter, the expert council) attached to the Tourism Committee of the City of Moscow.
moscow35-uef23a54ca02fa71a32-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM

moscow35-u2a10a6717d667d69bb-1.text: 9. After discussing the materials and works submitted for the Prize, the expert council shall adopt at its meetings a decision recommending the award of the current year’s Prizes, by an open vote and a majority of those present.
moscow35-u2a10a6717d667d69bb-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM

moscow35-ub50b522c703d220d9e-2.text: Where materials and works authored by members of the expert council are submitted for the Prize, those members shall be temporarily excluded from participation in the expert council’s work.
moscow35-ub50b522c703d220d9e-2.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM

moscow35-u85f66a8d7a01fff892-1.text: 10. The materials and works selected by the expert council shall be forwarded by the Tourism Committee of the City of Moscow to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow for subsequent submission to the Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow.
moscow35-u85f66a8d7a01fff892-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM

moscow35-uce6375b93467632c01-2.text: 11. On the basis of proposals from the Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow, a Decree of the Mayor of Moscow on awarding the Prizes shall be issued.
moscow35-uce6375b93467632c01-2.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM

moscow35-u318c4bf32a425f20e9-1.text: 12. The Prizes shall be paid by the Tourism Committee of the City of Moscow on the basis of the Decree of the Mayor of Moscow on awarding the Prizes.
moscow35-u318c4bf32a425f20e9-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM

moscow35-ua738f3ce9ace9dfdbe-3.text: 13. Where the Prize is awarded to a team of authors, its monetary component shall be divided equally among them.
moscow35-ua738f3ce9ace9dfdbe-3.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM

moscow35-u8dfbf0e307c00ca369-1.text: 14. A laureate may receive the Prize again for new major achievements in tourism.
moscow35-u8dfbf0e307c00ca369-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM

moscow35-u552d7e8ccb4ca19e9e-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMENDATION OF THE MAYOR OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u5ae93bc3244b2b6c57-1.text: The Commendation of the Mayor of Moscow shall be granted to citizens of the Russian Federation and foreign citizens and to collectives of institutions and organizations for meritorious economic, research, sociocultural, public and charitable activities aimed at improving the living conditions of Muscovites, for high achievements in training qualified personnel, educating the younger generation and maintaining legality and law and order, and for many years of impeccable work in the municipal economy of the City of Moscow.
moscow35-u5ae93bc3244b2b6c57-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMENDATION OF THE MAYOR OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u92fcd333de1f9468cf-1.text: Citizens granted the Commendation of the Mayor of Moscow shall receive a cash award in an amount established by the Government of Moscow. The cash award shall be paid by the Administrative Affairs Directorate of the Mayor and Government of Moscow.
moscow35-u92fcd333de1f9468cf-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMENDATION OF THE MAYOR OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u1d077b6ce5c04ec43a-1.text: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE “HONORARY WORKER IN INDUSTRY OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
moscow35-u1d077b6ce5c04ec43a-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE “HONORARY WORKER IN INDUSTRY OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-ud4f936036993142bc1-1.text: The honorary title “Honorary Worker in Industry of the City of Moscow” shall be conferred on:
moscow35-ud4f936036993142bc1-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE “HONORARY WORKER IN INDUSTRY OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-ud13d3f3fee99d1246d-1.text: - highly skilled workers and forepersons who have achieved high performance in output, product quality improvement and labour productivity and have worked directly on machine tools, units, apparatus, installations or process equipment of industrial organizations of the City of Moscow for at least 10 years;
moscow35-ud13d3f3fee99d1246d-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE “HONORARY WORKER IN INDUSTRY OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-u3c5a0032a59dc5cce3-1.text: - highly professional workers, forepersons and engineering and technical personnel of industrial associations and organizations who have especially distinguished themselves in improving equipment, technology and production organization, made a major personal contribution to improving product quality, expanding product ranges and reducing production costs, raising labour productivity and production efficiency through mechanization and automation of production processes and scientific advances, and making rational use of capacity and material resources, and have worked in the industry of the City of Moscow for at least 15 years;
moscow35-u3c5a0032a59dc5cce3-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE “HONORARY WORKER IN INDUSTRY OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-ued671a2a625410a314-1.text: - highly professional researchers who have made a major personal contribution to technical progress, the development and introduction of new equipment and technologies, and the organization of production and labour, and have worked in research, design and development or other organizations and institutions of the City of Moscow for at least 15 years.
moscow35-ued671a2a625410a314-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE “HONORARY WORKER IN INDUSTRY OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-ud80a64a1d0696b5594-1.text: Persons conferred the honorary title “Honorary Worker in Industry of the City of Moscow” shall receive a cash award in an amount established by the Government of Moscow. The cash award shall be paid by the Administrative Affairs Directorate of the Mayor and Government of Moscow.
moscow35-ud80a64a1d0696b5594-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE “HONORARY WORKER IN INDUSTRY OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-u3fd92f14b4bd7342fa-1.text: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE “HONORARY FIGURE IN SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
moscow35-u3fd92f14b4bd7342fa-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE “HONORARY FIGURE IN SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-ue1710b4092f074e859-1.text: The honorary title “Honorary Figure in Science and Technology of the City of Moscow” shall be conferred on eminent scientists holding a Doctor of Sciences degree for a major personal contribution to developing the principal fields of science and technology, founding scientific schools and educating and training research personnel, and on highly professional employees of research, design, technological and production organizations and institutions for significant merit in developing and introducing new highly efficient equipment and technologies matching the highest world achievements and enabling major economic problems to be resolved, who have worked productively in the City of Moscow for at least 15 years.
moscow35-ue1710b4092f074e859-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE “HONORARY FIGURE IN SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-u79eb80df819f95589c-1.text: Persons conferred the honorary title “Honorary Figure in Science and Technology of the City of Moscow” shall receive a cash award in an amount established by the Government of Moscow. The cash award shall be paid by the Administrative Affairs Directorate of the Mayor and Government of Moscow.
moscow35-u79eb80df819f95589c-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE “HONORARY FIGURE IN SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-u19bef15beb5e1c66e7-1.text: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE “HONORARY WORKER IN EDUCATION OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
moscow35-u19bef15beb5e1c66e7-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE “HONORARY WORKER IN EDUCATION OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-u1e459aaad5a7b75266-1.text: The honorary title ‘Honorary Worker in Education of the City of Moscow’ is conferred on highly professional teaching staff, academic teaching staff and other employees of organisations engaged in educational activities, support for educational activities or assessment of the quality of education in the territory of the City of Moscow, state civil servants of the City of Moscow serving in the Department of Education and Science of the City of Moscow, and municipal servants serving in the Education Directorate of the Administration of the Troitsk Urban Okrug, for merits in teaching, upbringing, scientific and methodological activities, productive work in training highly qualified specialists and a major personal contribution to the organisation and development of education, provided that they have worked in education in the City of Moscow for at least 10 years.
moscow35-u1e459aaad5a7b75266-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE “HONORARY WORKER IN EDUCATION OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-ud52770292000fcd832-1.text: Persons conferred the honorary title ‘Honorary Worker in Education of the City of Moscow’ receive a cash award in the amount established by the Government of Moscow. The cash award is paid by the Administrative Affairs Directorate of the Mayor and Government of Moscow.
moscow35-ud52770292000fcd832-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE “HONORARY WORKER IN EDUCATION OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

moscow35-u0b35eb4bb883d02cc2-1.text: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE ‘HONORARY WORKER IN HEALTHCARE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
moscow35-u0b35eb4bb883d02cc2-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE ‘HONORARY WORKER IN HEALTHCARE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-ufb32314be35ddf72c9-1.text: The honorary title ‘Honorary Worker in Healthcare of the City of Moscow’ is conferred on highly professional graduate pharmacists, pharmacy technicians, engineering and technical staff, service staff and other personnel of medical and preventive, sanitary and preventive, sanatorium and resort, and pharmacy institutions, health authorities, research, medical and pharmaceutical institutes, organisations, institutions and associations, for a major personal contribution to the organisation and development of healthcare, merits in protecting public health and personal achievements in improving the quality of medical care and the supply of medicines, provided that they have worked in the field of protecting citizens’ health in the City of Moscow for at least 10 years.
moscow35-ufb32314be35ddf72c9-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE ‘HONORARY WORKER IN HEALTHCARE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-u79944c80fa1285dcd9-1.text: Persons conferred the honorary title ‘Honorary Worker in Healthcare of the City of Moscow’ receive a cash award in the amount established by the Government of Moscow. The cash award is paid by the Administrative Affairs Directorate of the Mayor and Government of Moscow.
moscow35-u79944c80fa1285dcd9-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE ‘HONORARY WORKER IN HEALTHCARE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-ue88e717a1cbadfd890-1.text: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE ‘HONORARY MEDICAL WORKER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
moscow35-ue88e717a1cbadfd890-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE ‘HONORARY MEDICAL WORKER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-u9d29d9b1b8198e7586-1.text: The honorary title ‘Honorary Medical Worker of the City of Moscow’ is conferred on highly professional physicians and middle-level and junior medical personnel of medical organisations operating in the City of Moscow, for high professional achievements in providing primary healthcare, specialised medical care, including high-technology care, emergency medical care, including specialised emergency and palliative medical care, for merits in mastering and introducing new, including innovative, methods of diagnosing and treating patients, and a personal contribution to the development of healthcare in the City of Moscow, provided that they have worked in the field of protecting citizens’ health in the City of Moscow for at least 10 years.
moscow35-u9d29d9b1b8198e7586-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE ‘HONORARY MEDICAL WORKER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-u63a8004d901cc190f3-1.text: Persons conferred the honorary title ‘Honorary Medical Worker of the City of Moscow’ receive a cash award in the amount established by the Government of Moscow. The cash award is paid by the Administrative Affairs Directorate of the Mayor and Government of Moscow.
moscow35-u63a8004d901cc190f3-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE ‘HONORARY MEDICAL WORKER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-u67d247fdeb39fbf00f-1.text: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE ‘HONORARY FIGURE IN THE ARTS OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
moscow35-u67d247fdeb39fbf00f-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE ‘HONORARY FIGURE IN THE ARTS OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-u60c13e3532978755ef-1.text: The honorary title ‘Honorary Figure in the Arts of the City of Moscow’ is conferred on highly professional directors, choreographers, conductors, choirmasters, composers, performing artists, musicians, playwrights, visual artists, architects, designers, art scholars and other figures in the arts, for a major personal contribution to the development of culture and art, merits in creating works of high artistic quality that have received public recognition and scholarly works, outstanding performance skills, and achievements in educating and training creative personnel, provided that they have worked in the arts in the City of Moscow for at least 15 years.
moscow35-u60c13e3532978755ef-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE ‘HONORARY FIGURE IN THE ARTS OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-uf8285af0f755d384a8-1.text: Persons conferred the honorary title ‘Honorary Figure in the Arts of the City of Moscow’ receive a cash award in the amount established by the Government of Moscow. The cash award is paid by the Administrative Affairs Directorate of the Mayor and Government of Moscow.
moscow35-uf8285af0f755d384a8-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE ‘HONORARY FIGURE IN THE ARTS OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
