moscow35-uda4bdef25966d63d1e-1.text: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
moscow35-uda4bdef25966d63d1e-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u59747bc9e8cd92744f-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-ue104185837e46fa59b-1.text: 1. These Instructions establish the procedure for initiating and considering petitions for the distinctions ‘For Services to Moscow’ and ‘For Impeccable Service to the City of Moscow’, the honorary badges ‘Honoured Teacher of the City of Moscow’, ‘Honoured Physician of the City of Moscow’ and ‘Honoured Industrialist of the City of Moscow’, the award of Prizes of the City of Moscow and the declaration of the Commendation of the Mayor of Moscow (hereinafter, awards), and for conferring professional honorary titles of the City of Moscow (hereinafter, honorary titles) <*>, preparing award documentation, presenting awards and breast badges for honorary titles, and issuing recipients with duplicates of lost awards, breast badges for honorary titles and the associated documents.
moscow35-ue104185837e46fa59b-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u226f21664df33dd314-1.text: 2. Executive authorities and local self-government bodies, institutions and organisations of the City of Moscow organise the granting of awards and conferral of honorary titles on citizens in accordance with Law of the City of Moscow of 05.09.2001 No. 38 ‘On Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow’, this Decree and other normative legal acts concerning awards and honorary titles.
moscow35-u226f21664df33dd314-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-ud418ed4f7143ad08fd-1.text: 3. Citizens (workforces, organisations) are nominated for awards and honorary titles for services to Moscow and a significant contribution to the socioeconomic, scientific, technological and cultural development of the city, and for specific outstanding achievements in professional and charitable activities.
moscow35-ud418ed4f7143ad08fd-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-ueb118386d078914817-1.text: 4. Simultaneous nomination of citizens (workforces, organisations) for awards and honorary titles is not permitted.
moscow35-ueb118386d078914817-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u20499a6cb45bd6a6df-1.text: 5. A further award for new merits may be granted no earlier than five years after the previous award or conferral of an honorary title (including receipt of a state award of the Russian Federation), except for nominations for courage and selfless actions shown in the performance of official or civic duty.
moscow35-u20499a6cb45bd6a6df-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u74eb35188121d0e751-1.text: By decision of the Mayor of Moscow, a further award may be granted before the expiry of the 5-year period.
moscow35-u74eb35188121d0e751-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-ub57a0188887de2288e-1.text: 6. Repeat nomination for awards of the same name is not permitted unless otherwise provided by the regulations governing those awards.
moscow35-ub57a0188887de2288e-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u03818ff73f76ada104-1.text: 7. Nominations of citizens (workforces, organisations) for awards and honorary titles must not be made on a mass basis. They are strictly selective and are made only where other incentives have been exhausted or where such incentives would not correspond to the significance of the merits and achievements.
moscow35-u03818ff73f76ada104-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u19196e7609bc9cf97d-1.text: In exceptional cases, for particularly outstanding services to Moscow, the Mayor of Moscow decides to grant an award or confer an honorary title without applying the requirements established by the regulations governing those awards or honorary titles.
moscow35-u19196e7609bc9cf97d-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-ufb0a9bb112df9c459c-1.text: <*> The procedure for conferring the honorary title ‘Honorary Citizen of the City of Moscow’ is determined by a law of the City of Moscow.
moscow35-ufb0a9bb112df9c459c-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u83c35ef2cb80993c61-1.text: The procedure for awarding the Certificate of Honour and the Honorary Diploma of the Moscow City Duma is established by the Moscow City Duma; the procedure for awarding the Certificate of Honour of the Government of Moscow is established by the Government of Moscow.
moscow35-u83c35ef2cb80993c61-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u15bd86b2a8b1d19faa-1.text: 2. Procedure for nomination for awards and honorary titles of the City
moscow35-u15bd86b2a8b1d19faa-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-ud1a32319ff57db2933-1.text: 8. Petitions for awards and the conferral of honorary titles (hereinafter, award petitions) are initiated by the workforces (creative teams) of the city’s institutions and organisations, and by state authorities and local self-government bodies.
moscow35-ud1a32319ff57db2933-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-uc5a9a494752c749c2c-1.text: Residents of Moscow may submit proposals to grant awards and confer honorary titles on individual citizens and workforces. These proposals are sent to local self-government bodies, which consider them together with the institutions and organisations employing the citizens proposed for awards and take the appropriate decision.
moscow35-uc5a9a494752c749c2c-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u80afaa100644b175ef-1.text: Award requests based on citizens’ personal applications are not considered.
moscow35-u80afaa100644b175ef-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u10f435f67f48450af6-1.text: Petitions to grant awards to organisations are initiated by sectoral, functional and territorial executive authorities and local self-government bodies.
moscow35-u10f435f67f48450af6-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u2ac3078ba5ed017c00-1.text: Petitions to grant awards to individual citizens may be initiated by sectoral, functional and territorial executive authorities in agreement with the management of the institution or organisation employing the citizens concerned.
moscow35-u2ac3078ba5ed017c00-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-ua670fb620cae7eba95-1.text: 9. Foreign citizens and stateless persons permanently residing in the City of Moscow or in the territory of the Russian Federation are nominated for awards and honorary titles on the general grounds, in agreement with the Department for External Economic and International Relations of the City of Moscow.
moscow35-ua670fb620cae7eba95-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u1419c841f294ea8dd2-1.text: Petitions to grant awards to Russian citizens working outside the Russian Federation, and to foreign citizens and stateless persons residing abroad, are initiated by the Department for External Economic and International Relations of the City of Moscow or by other sectoral and functional executive authorities of the city in agreement with that Department.
moscow35-u1419c841f294ea8dd2-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-ub82b3798acba3fa895-1.text: 10. Nominations for awards and honorary titles for staff of the offices of federal state authorities and federal state bodies, military personnel, personnel of the internal affairs bodies of the Russian Federation, the State Fire Service of the Ministry of the Russian Federation for Civil Defence, Emergencies and Elimination of Consequences of Natural Disasters, federal security service bodies, institutions and bodies of the penal enforcement system, prosecution bodies, customs authorities of the Russian Federation, the Investigative Committee of the Russian Federation and the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, judges and prosecutors, and civilian personnel of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation are submitted to the Mayor of Moscow by the heads of the relevant federal state authorities or federal state bodies, or by the heads of their territorial structures in the City of Moscow.
moscow35-ub82b3798acba3fa895-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u5824061b8be25e10b9-1.text: Where necessary, those nominations are subject to endorsement by the relevant sectoral and functional executive authorities of the City of Moscow.
moscow35-u5824061b8be25e10b9-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u8840b8ae43daebf519-1.text: 11. Petitions to grant awards to citizens are drawn up on the award nomination form and must contain biographical information on the candidate and a description of the candidate’s specific achievements and merits (the procedure for completing the award nomination form is set out in Annex 1 to these Instructions).
moscow35-u8840b8ae43daebf519-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-ub3311cb12f9f6ac1de-1.text: When candidates and works are nominated for prizes, the following are submitted with the award nomination form (or with the petition when a team of authors is nominated): a copy of the decision of the institution’s or organisation’s workforce to nominate the candidate (team of authors) for the prize; certificates and documents confirming the release of the work and the date and place of its publication (performance, exhibition, construction and commissioning) or practical application (implementation); materials demonstrating broad public recognition of the work or candidate nominated for the prize (reviews published in the press and specialists’ assessments and opinions); and materials providing a visual or other illustrative representation of the nominated work (books, photographs, reproductions, audio and video cassettes, posters, programmes and other illustrative materials).
moscow35-ub3311cb12f9f6ac1de-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u8ebed531f2ea58b648-1.text: When petitions are initiated for awards to workforces and organisations, the head of the organisation, local self-government body or territorial executive authority of the city draws up a free-form petition specifying the production, scientific, creative or other achievements of the workforce, institution or organisation.
moscow35-u8ebed531f2ea58b648-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-ub001d934ad320dc555-1.text: When a petition is initiated for the honorary title ‘Honorary Inventor of the City of Moscow’, the award nomination form is accompanied by copies of patents (inventor’s certificates) for the invention, utility model or industrial design, information on their practical application, and a written opinion of the Moscow City Organisation of the public organisation, the All-Russian Society of Inventors and Rationalisers.
moscow35-ub001d934ad320dc555-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u98ff99d1f5634405a8-1.text: 12. Officials who initiate award petitions bear personal responsibility for the correctness and reliability of the information in award nomination forms, petitions for awards to workforces and organisations, and other documents submitted as supporting materials.
moscow35-u98ff99d1f5634405a8-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-ufc6549c18c22a7b35c-1.text: 13. Heads of institutions and organisations (except those subordinate to the prefectures of the administrative districts of the City of Moscow) obtain endorsement of award nomination forms from the heads of the relevant sectoral or functional executive authorities of the City of Moscow and from the Deputy Mayor of Moscow in the Government of Moscow who supervises and coordinates the work of the relevant sectoral or functional executive authority.
moscow35-ufc6549c18c22a7b35c-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-ud7327e2440767608d3-1.text: Heads of institutions and organisations subordinate to the prefectures of the administrative districts of the City of Moscow obtain endorsement of award nomination forms from the prefect of the relevant administrative district and from the Deputy Mayor of Moscow in the Government of Moscow who supervises and coordinates the work of the territorial executive authorities of the City of Moscow.
moscow35-ud7327e2440767608d3-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u3ffe8ce721c4421e56-1.text: Heads of institutions and organisations send the duly endorsed materials to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow.
moscow35-u3ffe8ce721c4421e56-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u09f05bfd17d862fbc5-1.text: 14. Upon receipt by sectoral or functional executive authorities, prize nomination materials are forwarded for consideration to the relevant expert councils (commissions) for awarding prizes.
moscow35-u09f05bfd17d862fbc5-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u136a8b730994fc1db4-1.text: The expert councils (commissions) comprehensively examine the materials, arrange broad public exposure of the work (candidate), analyse the assessments, reviews and specialist opinions received, and other documents describing the work or prize candidate, and at their meetings adopt a decision recommending the award of prizes or rejection of the petition. Award materials signed by the chair of the expert council and endorsed by the head of the sectoral or functional executive authority are forwarded to the Deputy Mayor of Moscow in the Government of Moscow who supervises and coordinates the work of the relevant sectoral or functional executive authority of the City of Moscow. The duly endorsed materials, together with the minutes of the expert council meeting (bearing the original signatures of the members who participated in the vote), are sent to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow.
moscow35-u136a8b730994fc1db4-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-uaa6a5760f60382fc8c-1.text: 15. During the endorsement of award petitions, the head of any endorsing authority may decline to support a petition or propose changing the type of award, explaining the reasons for the decision.
moscow35-uaa6a5760f60382fc8c-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u0cc6cdd327d7d1c4b3-1.text: 16. If the biographical information of a person nominated for an award changes, or circumstances arise that prevent the award, the head of the institution or organisation shall immediately notify the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow.
moscow35-u0cc6cdd327d7d1c4b3-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u54cc6ccf17402e9881-1.text: 17. Duly endorsed award petitions are submitted to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow, which, after examining and checking the award materials, forwards them to the Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow <**> or refuses to accept materials submitted in breach of the prescribed procedure.
moscow35-u54cc6ccf17402e9881-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u31fc75e70f9e392c67-1.text: 18. The Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow considers the award petitions and expert councils’ recommendations for prizes received and adopts a reasoned decision to support or reject them.
moscow35-u31fc75e70f9e392c67-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u25e570e04c33423904-1.text: On the basis of the Commission’s decision, the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow prepares draft legal acts of the Mayor of Moscow granting awards and conferring honorary titles (hereinafter, award legal acts), or sends reasoned refusals to the institutions, organisations, executive authorities and local self-government bodies that submitted the award petitions.
moscow35-u25e570e04c33423904-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u2fe1fc3932a654395a-1.text: 19. Copies of award legal acts (extracts) are sent by the Executive Office of the Mayor and Government of Moscow to the heads of federal state authorities, federal state bodies and territorial, sectoral and functional executive authorities of the City of Moscow, who in turn send extracts from the Mayor’s legal acts to subordinate organisations insofar as they concern them.
moscow35-u2fe1fc3932a654395a-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-ud28b2c0107f6e7fb66-1.text: 20. On the basis of the copies of the Mayor of Moscow’s award legal acts or extracts received, the personnel departments of institutions and organisations enter the appropriate award records in recipients’ personnel files, employment record books (where available) and other records.
moscow35-ud28b2c0107f6e7fb66-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u7871dfd3571634e6e0-1.text: 21. The Mayor of Moscow revokes an award legal act if the nomination for the award (honorary title) is found to be inaccurate or unfounded.
moscow35-u7871dfd3571634e6e0-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u3a2168a294ed96cba3-1.text: The award (breast badge for an honorary title) and its document presented to a person in respect of whom a decree revoking the award has been issued must be returned to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow. Officials responsible for an unfounded nomination for an award (honorary title) bear personal responsibility.
moscow35-u3a2168a294ed96cba3-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u092c663d7bf23c5c29-1.text: 22. The Mayor of Moscow may restore a citizen’s rights to awards (an honorary title) if the citizen is rehabilitated or if the act for which the recipient was deprived of the awards has ceased to be socially dangerous.
moscow35-u092c663d7bf23c5c29-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u1850257e65e05fa642-1.text: Restoration of rights to an award is considered on the basis of a petition initiated by a local self-government body or the head of an organisation following the citizen’s personal application, under the procedure established for nomination for awards and honorary titles. The petition must be accompanied by a certificate from the relevant archive confirming the award, a rehabilitation certificate, a certificate from the penal enforcement authorities confirming completion of the sentence or release on parole from imprisonment, and other documents supporting an objective decision on the possibility of restoring rights to the award. After the Mayor’s decree restoring rights to awards enters into force, the awards and their documents are returned to the recipient.
moscow35-u1850257e65e05fa642-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u0c166470bafd5394d0-1.text: <**> The Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow is established in accordance with Law of the City of Moscow of 05.09.2001 No. 38 ‘On Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow’. Its Regulations and membership are approved by the Mayor of Moscow.
moscow35-u0c166470bafd5394d0-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u579671912df1a590d3-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-ue99e33fadf42d46b60-1.text: 23. Awards and breast badges for honorary titles are presented by the Mayor of Moscow.
moscow35-ue99e33fadf42d46b60-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-ufa2337aae4ef7532e0-1.text: On the instructions of the Mayor of Moscow, they may be presented by Deputy Mayors of Moscow in the Government of Moscow, heads of territorial, sectoral and functional executive authorities of the City of Moscow, and other officials authorised by the Mayor of Moscow.
moscow35-ufa2337aae4ef7532e0-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-uffbd0c1472b4341fbe-1.text: Awards and breast badges for honorary titles (hereinafter, presentation of awards) are presented no later than two months after the relevant award legal act is issued.
moscow35-uffbd0c1472b4341fbe-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u1dd678de2b0f560083-1.text: 24. Officials entrusted with presenting awards are responsible for their timely and proper presentation. 25. Awards are presented in a solemn and public setting at events specially organised for that purpose. The relevant certificates or diplomas are issued at the same time.
moscow35-u1dd678de2b0f560083-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-udee1cceaeb4b8eacdd-1.text: 26. Awards and their documents whose presentation is entrusted to heads of territorial, sectoral and functional executive authorities are collected from the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow by staff of those authorities’ personnel units under a power of attorney.
moscow35-udee1cceaeb4b8eacdd-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u0717a2dfdf9e05426c-1.text: 27. Awards and documents received by personnel units for presentation to recipients are entered in register books (cards) in accordance with the established procedure for accounting for material assets.
moscow35-u0717a2dfdf9e05426c-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-ue3d13a66eb00204f07-1.text: Storage arrangements for awards and their documents must ensure full protection against theft, fire and damage. Awards and their documents are kept in safes or metal cabinets in rooms inaccessible to unauthorised persons.
moscow35-ue3d13a66eb00204f07-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u7b240c69855be85a2b-1.text: By an administrative order (executive order) of the head of the organisation, custody of awards and their documents is entrusted to a designated employee who bears financial liability for their safekeeping <*>.
moscow35-u7b240c69855be85a2b-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u84d6494e31d99614d2-1.text: 28. Forms of the Commendation of the Mayor of Moscow and certificates for awards are completed neatly and legibly in black drawing ink or using a personal computer; no corrections are permitted.
moscow35-u84d6494e31d99614d2-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-ud4582e40742884f464-1.text: The Mayor’s signature on award certificates and the Commendation of the Mayor of Moscow is authenticated with the official coat-of-arms seal ‘Mayor of Moscow’.
moscow35-ud4582e40742884f464-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u7bf5505288eb197360-1.text: 29. Blank award documents spoiled during completion or otherwise damaged are returned to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow.
moscow35-u7bf5505288eb197360-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-ubf03464c1f4d7f7b71-1.text: 30. Award certificates have no expiry date and are not replaced when the recipient changes surname, first name or patronymic.
moscow35-ubf03464c1f4d7f7b71-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u3b2cf74aaa8a3441ec-1.text: 31. A record of the presentation of awards is drawn up and carefully checked against the award legal act (or extract). Corrections and erasures in the records are not permitted.
moscow35-u3b2cf74aaa8a3441ec-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u7dcde3dece079a6be7-1.text: The record is signed by the person who presented the awards and affixed with an official coat-of-arms seal. A copy is made and certified with a seal and the signature of an authorised person. No later than three working days after presentation of the award, the record is submitted to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow, and a certified copy to the Administrative Affairs Directorate of the Mayor and Government of Moscow.
moscow35-u7dcde3dece079a6be7-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u3f44c0c3f4299166fb-1.text: 32. If errors are discovered in decrees or executive orders of the Mayor of Moscow granting awards (incorrect surname, first name, patronymic or job title), a statement amending the recipient’s surname (first name, patronymic or position) is drawn up and signed by the official who presented the award.
moscow35-u3f44c0c3f4299166fb-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-ub19e354c7b373e3f11-1.text: The petition to correct the Mayor of Moscow’s award decree or executive order and the statement are submitted with the award presentation record to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow.
moscow35-ub19e354c7b373e3f11-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-uf314e5c232149b694d-1.text: 33. If an award cannot be presented because the recipient has changed workplace or residence or the recipient’s employment has ended, the head of the personnel unit entrusted with organising the presentation sends a notification and returns the unpresented award and its document to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow, which takes steps to organise its presentation.
moscow35-uf314e5c232149b694d-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u48ac84ce4748441102-1.text: If a recipient cannot attend the award ceremony for health reasons, the award may, with the recipient’s consent, be presented at home or in a medical institution.
moscow35-u48ac84ce4748441102-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u93ba2a2753d91143fa-1.text: <*> The procedure for recording and storing awards of the City of Moscow in the Awards Section of the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow is established in accordance with the Instructions on the Procedure for Recording and Storing Orders, Medals, Distinctions, Breast Badges for Honorary Titles of the Russian Federation and Blank Documents Relating to Them, approved by Executive Order of the President of the Russian Federation of 14.10.1997 No. 417-рп.
moscow35-u93ba2a2753d91143fa-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u77e657763aa00043c6-1.text: 4. Procedure for transferring deceased recipients’ awards to their heirs
moscow35-u77e657763aa00043c6-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u9219eeebbd9f11ac30-1.text: 34. Deceased recipients’ awards and the associated documents are transferred to their heirs—spouse (husband, wife), children (son, daughter), parents (father, mother)—for safekeeping as mementoes, without the right to wear the awards. 35. The awards and associated documents of deceased recipients are transferred in the order in which the heirs are listed. Disputes between heirs are resolved by them through judicial proceedings.
moscow35-u9219eeebbd9f11ac30-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u915315f5b4dc060a07-1.text: 36. The Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow organises the transfer of awards to the heirs of deceased recipients.
moscow35-u915315f5b4dc060a07-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u7813dc0750b8631d32-1.text: 37. Officials who transfer an award and its document to a recipient’s heir must submit a record of that transfer to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow no later than 5 days after the transfer.
moscow35-u7813dc0750b8631d32-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u91d9b7a0346236094e-1.text: 38. If a recipient has no heirs, the awards and their documents must be returned to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow.
moscow35-u91d9b7a0346236094e-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u390993d614eca587de-1.text: 5. Procedure for initiating petitions for duplicates of lost awards and their documents
moscow35-u390993d614eca587de-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u6e94799fc164898880-1.text: 39. If awards and their documents are lost in combat, as a result of a natural disaster or in other circumstances in which their loss could not be prevented, recipients may be issued duplicates of the awards by decision of the Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow.
moscow35-u6e94799fc164898880-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-ucab2707a9bf7001ca0-1.text: Duplicates of the Certificate of Honour of the Government of Moscow, the diploma for a Prize of the City of Moscow and the Commendation of the Mayor of Moscow are not issued. If they are lost, the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow may issue recipients with certificates confirming the award of the Certificate of Honour, the granting of the prize or the declaration of the Commendation of the Mayor of Moscow.
moscow35-ucab2707a9bf7001ca0-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-uff91b07b4bcc8f1e8a-1.text: 40. Recipients report the loss of awards in applications to the head of the organisation at their place of work; those not employed apply to local self-government bodies at their place of residence.
moscow35-uff91b07b4bcc8f1e8a-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-uf6d6751d471e1079ae-1.text: Recipients who have lost awards on the grounds specified in paragraph 39 of these Instructions may petition the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow for duplicates.
moscow35-uf6d6751d471e1079ae-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u948972bd450e90d67e-1.text: In addition to the request for a duplicate award, the application states the recipient’s position, surname, first name, patronymic and year of birth, and describes the circumstances of the loss. It is accompanied by documents confirming the award (copies of award certificates or an archival certificate confirming the award), a certificate from the relevant state body or institution confirming the circumstances of the loss, and a character reference from the recipient’s most recent place of work or, for a person not employed, from the place of residence.
moscow35-u948972bd450e90d67e-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-uf7341c73e0dfbebc54-1.text: 41. If awards are stolen, the recipient reports the theft to the internal affairs bodies. A petition for duplicates is initiated after one year has elapsed from the date those bodies were notified of the theft. In addition to the documents specified in paragraph 40 of these Instructions, the application must include a certificate from the internal affairs body concerning the recipient’s report of the theft and the results of the search for the awards.
moscow35-uf7341c73e0dfbebc54-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u72018cb6d1b61bccfd-1.text: 42. The Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow considers applications for duplicate awards received and forwards them to the Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow, which takes the appropriate decision.
moscow35-u72018cb6d1b61bccfd-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u89b115d310a6c02b8b-1.text: 43. The Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow issues duplicate awards to recipients on the basis of a decision of the Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow.
moscow35-u89b115d310a6c02b8b-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u5c1dfff04dc33a2e84-1.text: The letter ‘д’ (duplicate) is reproduced on the reverse of duplicate awards.
moscow35-u5c1dfff04dc33a2e84-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u4da60038731fa0241f-1.text: 44. Petitions for duplicates of lost award documents are initiated under the procedure established for duplicate awards (paragraphs 39–43 of these Instructions). A character reference for the person who lost the award document is not required.
moscow35-u4da60038731fa0241f-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u966db8feb49c579ecc-1.text: 45. In cases other than those specified in paragraph 39 of these Instructions, the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow issues certificates confirming the award instead of duplicate award documents.
moscow35-u966db8feb49c579ecc-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u65653a6851bfda5326-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-uc65c1ab249bc2c890f-1.text: 46. Where a recipient has state awards of the Russian Federation and the USSR, awards of the City of Moscow are placed after or below the state awards of the Russian Federation.
moscow35-uc65c1ab249bc2c890f-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-uf682e09cfed19ec583-1.text: 47. Distinctions, the honorary badges ‘Honoured Teacher of the City of Moscow’, ‘Honoured Physician of the City of Moscow’ and ‘Honoured Industrialist of the City of Moscow’, the breast badge ‘Laureate of the Prize of the City of Moscow’, the breast badge for the Certificate of Honour of the Government of Moscow and breast badges for honorary titles are worn on the right side of the chest.
moscow35-uf682e09cfed19ec583-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u1a17b9be680e4609e4-1.text: Where there are several awards and honorary titles, they are arranged from left to right in the following order: the distinctions ‘For Impeccable Service to the City of Moscow’ for L, XL, XXX, XXV and XX years; the honorary badges ‘Honoured Teacher of the City of Moscow’, ‘Honoured Physician of the City of Moscow’ and ‘Honoured Industrialist of the City of Moscow’; the breast badge ‘Laureate of the Prize of the City of Moscow’; the breast badge for the Certificate of Honour of the Government of Moscow; and the breast badge for an honorary title.
moscow35-u1a17b9be680e4609e4-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-u8aa1049eabb53c42b4-1.text: Recipients of awards and honorary titles may wear the distinctions, honorary badges, breast badges, their miniature copies or their lapel badges.
moscow35-u8aa1049eabb53c42b4-1.locator: INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCEDURE FOR GRANTING AWARDS AND CONFERRING HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow35-ue0a29f9f36d67f7378-1.text: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS
moscow35-ue0a29f9f36d67f7378-1.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS

moscow35-u6fd41ea3d60fe47a3f-1.text: The award nomination form is prepared on a sheet of A3 paper using a computer or typewriter.
moscow35-u6fd41ea3d60fe47a3f-1.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS

moscow35-u2904033e281ba1b04a-1.text: No shortened forms, abbreviations, inaccuracies or corrections are permitted when completing the award nomination form.
moscow35-u2904033e281ba1b04a-1.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS

moscow35-u8e7207fe1836e20986-1.text: The following information is entered in the appropriate items of the award nomination form:
moscow35-u8e7207fe1836e20986-1.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS

moscow35-ucb3b2f4ed001f8e747-1.text: - the name of the administrative district and district of the City of Moscow in whose territory the nominating organisation is located according to the legal entity’s address entered in the Unified State Register of Legal Entities;
moscow35-ucb3b2f4ed001f8e747-1.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS

moscow35-ue924ce8f50906a71ca-1.text: - the name of the award or honorary title in accordance with Law of the City of Moscow of 05.09.2001 No. 38 ‘On Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow’;
moscow35-ue924ce8f50906a71ca-1.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS

moscow35-ua7477d969436867d6b-1.text: - the nominee’s surname, first name and patronymic (in the nominative case), date of birth (day, month, year) and place of birth, as stated in the passport or other identity document;
moscow35-ua7477d969436867d6b-1.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS

moscow35-ub6db89b443425549be-1.text: - the nominee’s position and place of work, as recorded in the employment record book (service contract or other documents confirming the performance of official duties in the position held) or duly certified employment history information, including the full name of the organisation, state authority or local self-government body (in the genitive case) in accordance with documents confirming the information entered in the Unified State Register of Legal Entities;
moscow35-ub6db89b443425549be-1.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS

moscow35-u1f5df240f1062092a1-1.text: - the nominee’s education and speciality as stated in the diploma (including the full name of the educational organisation and year of graduation);
moscow35-u1f5df240f1062092a1-1.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS

moscow35-u3d4259def7434d5376-1.text: - the nominee’s academic degree, academic title and titles awarded by state academies of sciences;
moscow35-u3d4259def7434d5376-1.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS

moscow35-u6d1110b519f144ba18-1.text: - the nominee’s state awards, including state awards of the Russian Federation, the USSR and the RSFSR, with the year of award, in the following order: Russian Federation awards in chronological order, USSR awards in order of precedence (where there are several), and RSFSR awards;
moscow35-u6d1110b519f144ba18-1.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS

moscow35-u80d7cff31ccde6b533-1.text: - awards and honorary titles of the City of Moscow, awards of federal executive authorities and other incentives are listed in chronological order;
moscow35-u80d7cff31ccde6b533-1.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS

moscow35-uad0ba462e52d7ea941-1.text: - the nominee’s home address as stated in the passport or, if the identity document contains no place-of-residence information, in accordance with another document confirming residence, as well as the nominee’s contact telephone number and individual personal account insurance number;
moscow35-uad0ba462e52d7ea941-1.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS

moscow35-uab01a994ec9a7e2d04-1.text: - employment and service history (including study at vocational educational organisations and higher education organisations, military and other service), in accordance with entries in the employment record book or duly certified employment history information, education diplomas, the military service document and other documents confirming the nominee’s employment (performance of official duties). Study is listed only where it was full-time. Secondary employment is listed after the principal employment history;
moscow35-uab01a994ec9a7e2d04-1.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS

moscow35-u5f71a88cdc2818188a-1.text: - a character reference specifying the nominee’s particular merits over the last 5 years (over the last 10–15 years when petitioning for an honorary title of the City of Moscow), enabling an objective assessment of the nominee’s contribution to addressing the tasks of the City of Moscow’s socioeconomic, political and cultural development.
moscow35-u5f71a88cdc2818188a-1.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS

moscow35-u02c8cb6ba2b2e7d358-1.text: The character reference describes the nominee’s personal achievements in work and service, qualifications, effectiveness and quality of work, and participation in public activities. A life history, service record or list of job duties is not permitted.
moscow35-u02c8cb6ba2b2e7d358-1.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS

moscow35-u97563120c2105dcdf9-1.text: The character reference may continue on an additional separate sheet inserted in the award nomination form (no more than one page), signed by the head of the organisation, state authority or local self-government body and certified with a seal.
moscow35-u97563120c2105dcdf9-1.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS

moscow35-u7a9f2d15a281167f19-1.text: The award nomination form is signed by the head of the organisation, state authority or local self-government body and the chair (head) of the primary trade union organisation (if any), and certified with a seal.
moscow35-u7a9f2d15a281167f19-1.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS

moscow35-udaefa2dd602182f629-1.text: The award nomination form is endorsed by the head of the relevant executive authority of the City of Moscow and the Deputy Mayor of Moscow in the Government of Moscow who supervises and coordinates that authority’s work. The endorsing persons’ signatures are certified with a seal.
moscow35-udaefa2dd602182f629-1.locator: PROCEDURE FOR COMPLETING AWARD NOMINATION FORMS

moscow35-u59747bc9e8cd92744f-2.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-uaee7a110fc8aef2493-1.text: 1. The Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow (hereinafter, the Commission) is established by the Mayor of Moscow to ensure an objective approach to considering incentives for citizens and to conduct a public assessment of materials concerning the award to citizens of the distinctions ‘For Services to Moscow’ and ‘For Impeccable Service to the City of Moscow’ (hereinafter, distinctions), the honorary badges ‘Honoured Teacher of the City of Moscow’, ‘Honoured Physician of the City of Moscow’ and ‘Honoured Industrialist of the City of Moscow’, the granting of Prizes of the City of Moscow (hereinafter, prizes), and the conferral of professional honorary titles of the City of Moscow (hereinafter, honorary titles).
moscow35-uaee7a110fc8aef2493-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-u5397a758cf44155051-1.text: For preliminary consideration of petitions for distinctions and honorary titles in the various professional fields, public councils may be established by decision of the relevant heads within municipal administration complexes and sectoral and functional executive authorities of the City of Moscow.
moscow35-u5397a758cf44155051-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-u02894e96ffe5af476a-1.text: 2. In view of the particular nature of considering prize nomination materials, expert councils are established at the relevant sectoral and functional executive authorities to conduct a public assessment of works and candidates nominated for prizes.
moscow35-u02894e96ffe5af476a-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-u2d0e5397219d0c505f-1.text: Regulations on expert councils and their membership are approved by Deputy Mayors of Moscow in the Government of Moscow.
moscow35-u2d0e5397219d0c505f-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-u89f26f4da438609ea5-1.text: In individual cases, the Mayor of Moscow may establish commissions to consider the award of prizes.
moscow35-u89f26f4da438609ea5-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-u6d3a0b9d95b916b074-1.text: 3. The Commission is a standing advisory body attached to the Mayor of Moscow and exercises its powers on a voluntary basis. Its decisions are advisory.
moscow35-u6d3a0b9d95b916b074-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-u406417456a75ae8ea1-1.text: 4. The Commission’s individual membership is approved by the Mayor of Moscow and comprises First Deputy Mayors and Deputy Mayors of Moscow in the Government of Moscow, ministers of the Government of Moscow, representatives of public organisations and the most authoritative specialists.
moscow35-u406417456a75ae8ea1-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-uc8e4aa8e62af69cfbc-1.text: Representatives of the city’s organisations, scientists and specialists may be engaged as experts in the Commission’s work.
moscow35-uc8e4aa8e62af69cfbc-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-u151e13a72b07b0c59d-1.text: 5. In its activities, the Commission is guided by the Charter of the City of Moscow, Law of the City of Moscow of 05.09.2001 No. 38 ‘On Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow’, this Decree and other normative legal acts concerning awards and honorary titles.
moscow35-u151e13a72b07b0c59d-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-ud0d44a63aee5d2e93c-1.text: Commissions established by the Mayor of Moscow to consider the award of prizes conduct their activities by reference to these Regulations.
moscow35-ud0d44a63aee5d2e93c-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-u1f20d6e186f392d5a8-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-u80f2955ed7bebd04d3-1.text: 6. The Commission performs the following functions:
moscow35-u80f2955ed7bebd04d3-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-u94188d48728b29c499-1.text: - assesses petitions received for distinctions and honorary titles and considers expert councils’ recommendations for the award of prizes;
moscow35-u94188d48728b29c499-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-u40d2784c449ff040a4-1.text: - issues opinions on whether distinctions may be awarded, prizes granted or honorary titles conferred, or on rejecting the petitions and recommendations submitted;
moscow35-u40d2784c449ff040a4-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-ue0bca647dd9912cd49-1.text: - considers petitions for duplicates of distinctions, breast badges for honorary titles and prizes and their documents; for restoration of rights to distinctions and honorary titles; and for deprivation of distinctions and honorary titles where a nomination for an award (prize or honorary title) is found to be inaccurate or lacking in objectivity;
moscow35-ue0bca647dd9912cd49-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-u8cbfdca927a25328e9-1.text: - considers proposals to establish or abolish awards and honorary titles of the City of Moscow and prepares opinions on them;
moscow35-u8cbfdca927a25328e9-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-u387610288694e476af-1.text: - considers issues concerning the application of legislation on distinctions, prizes and honorary titles, and proposals to improve its application in practice;
moscow35-u387610288694e476af-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-u0491e084396afa6683-1.text: - issues opinions on draft laws of the City of Moscow and other draft legal acts concerning distinctions, prizes and honorary titles;
moscow35-u0491e084396afa6683-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-u8a517679b351a40840-1.text: - considers proposals, applications and complaints relating to distinctions, prizes and honorary titles;
moscow35-u8a517679b351a40840-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-uc33200eb33c35d99b5-1.text: - carries out individual instructions of the Mayor of Moscow concerning awards.
moscow35-uc33200eb33c35d99b5-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-ube30b0df82a880c0b7-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-u1d879e584d89b786e1-1.text: 7. To exercise the powers entrusted to it, the Commission has the right to:
moscow35-u1d879e584d89b786e1-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-u258ef2ad4e723f6b72-1.text: - request and receive from heads of the city’s executive authorities and local self-government bodies, organisations, institutions and public associations, or other officials, the materials and information necessary for its work, including information on criminal convictions and criminal or administrative liability of citizens nominated for awards;
moscow35-u258ef2ad4e723f6b72-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-uc0bad80fb7971e7417-1.text: - engage representatives of institutions and organisations connected with an issue under consideration at a Commission meeting, as well as employees of outside organisations, specialists and scientists, to prepare opinions on award materials submitted for consideration;
moscow35-uc0bad80fb7971e7417-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-u8b25044c37311b7384-1.text: - refuse to consider and return for revision documents that have been prepared poorly and carelessly;
moscow35-u8b25044c37311b7384-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-ua1d3aa2a8351041977-1.text: - hear representatives of institutions and organisations at its meetings on the application of the City of Moscow’s award legislation and on specific award petitions submitted to the Commission;
moscow35-ua1d3aa2a8351041977-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-uc6867a4c751be96bb0-1.text: - inform the Mayor of Moscow on matters within the Commission’s competence.
moscow35-uc6867a4c751be96bb0-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-u05e02ec764ceb64a8e-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-uf5bb1d08d19a48a8e6-1.text: 8. Commission meetings are held as award petitions are received, but at least once a month.
moscow35-uf5bb1d08d19a48a8e6-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-u145c51b06773ac92c3-1.text: Meetings are chaired by the chair of the Commission or, in the chair’s absence, by the deputy chair.
moscow35-u145c51b06773ac92c3-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-u97a555020988e49a12-1.text: 9. A Commission meeting has a quorum if more than half of its members are present.
moscow35-u97a555020988e49a12-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-u4b178d10e931bb89ea-1.text: Decisions are taken by a majority of the members present through an open vote, in the absence of candidates for awards or honorary titles. In the event of a tied vote, the chair of the Commission (or deputy chair) takes the final decision.
moscow35-u4b178d10e931bb89ea-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-u0b81bb269b4498142c-1.text: When a petition to grant an award (honorary title) to a Commission member is considered at a meeting, that member is temporarily excluded from the Commission’s work, and this is noted in the minutes.
moscow35-u0b81bb269b4498142c-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-u69aa13e855b19a3bd1-1.text: Representatives of organisations, scientists and specialists invited to a meeting do not participate in voting.
moscow35-u69aa13e855b19a3bd1-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-uaf58e5ac2e65a851cd-1.text: 10. The Commission’s decision is recorded in minutes signed by the chair (deputy chair) and the secretary of the Commission.
moscow35-uaf58e5ac2e65a851cd-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-uf1cd026e58f2f14f34-1.text: On the basis of the Commission’s decision, its chair (deputy chair) endorses the draft of the corresponding decree of the Mayor of Moscow.
moscow35-uf1cd026e58f2f14f34-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-u829edb183fdcbed084-1.text: 11. The secretary of the Commission is responsible for its clerical work, the storage and use of its documents, and monitoring timely implementation of its decisions.
moscow35-u829edb183fdcbed084-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-u24cbb50fd9be2004d8-1.text: 12. Organisational and technical support for the Commission’s work is provided by the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow.
moscow35-u24cbb50fd9be2004d8-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>

moscow35-u47c2fc6370f46425c1-1.text: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
moscow35-u47c2fc6370f46425c1-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-uc388a505c086d9c223-1.text: The honorary badge ‘Honoured Teacher of the City of Moscow’ is awarded to highly professional teaching staff of educational organisations implementing basic general education programmes (hereinafter, educational organisations) for personal merits:
moscow35-uc388a505c086d9c223-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-ubf89ead0ea3832e9c1-1.text: - in improving and developing the education system of the City of Moscow;
moscow35-ubf89ead0ea3832e9c1-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-u6177bfda117a8568b1-1.text: - in teaching activities ensuring sustained positive trends in learning indicators, high academic achievements by students, and the preparation of winners and prize-winners of regional, all-Russian and international Olympiads;
moscow35-u6177bfda117a8568b1-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-u9d226e34bbbd6e2703-1.text: - in developing and introducing into the educational process innovative teaching technologies, forms and methods, educational programmes and teaching and methodological manuals;
moscow35-u9d226e34bbbd6e2703-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-u4dd683ef7a7c761c93-1.text: - in organising and improving upbringing activities in the educational organisation and promoting students’ moral, intellectual and cultural development.
moscow35-u4dd683ef7a7c761c93-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-u03b0a1f3f416565feb-1.text: For the purposes of these Regulations, highly professional teaching staff means persons with the highest qualification category who have received state awards of the Russian Federation or the USSR, departmental awards or awards of the City of Moscow, or hold honorary titles of the City of Moscow, or are winners of professional skills competitions, and who have worked in the education system of the City of Moscow for at least 15 years.
moscow35-u03b0a1f3f416565feb-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-u198a1058529ee2b2cb-1.text: Persons awarded the honorary badge ‘Honoured Teacher of the City of Moscow’ receive a cash award of 300000 roubles. The Department of Education and Science of the City of Moscow pays the cash award on the basis of the Mayor of Moscow’s decision to award the honorary badge.
moscow35-u198a1058529ee2b2cb-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-u7ddbbff4308efa476e-1.text: Up to 100 honorary badges ‘Honoured Teacher of the City of Moscow’ are awarded annually.
moscow35-u7ddbbff4308efa476e-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-u20d595a524ed80ccdd-1.text: The honorary badge ‘Honoured Teacher of the City of Moscow’ is not awarded a second time to the same person.
moscow35-u20d595a524ed80ccdd-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED TEACHER OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-u26b3f5118740f61319-1.text: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED PHYSICIAN OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
moscow35-u26b3f5118740f61319-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED PHYSICIAN OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-u2702197d29464ce6eb-1.text: The honorary badge ‘Honoured Physician of the City of Moscow’ is the highest form of recognition for merits in healthcare in the City of Moscow.
moscow35-u2702197d29464ce6eb-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED PHYSICIAN OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-u9fa278986be5e9d269-1.text: The honorary badge ‘Honoured Physician of the City of Moscow’ is awarded to highly professional practising physicians of medical organisations within the state healthcare system of the City of Moscow, who possess professional expertise and organisational skills, actively participate in the public life of the capital’s healthcare sector and in medical research, and are highly rated by colleagues and patients.
moscow35-u9fa278986be5e9d269-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED PHYSICIAN OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-u40c66e6842c47e294d-1.text: Physicians are awarded the honorary badge ‘Honoured Physician of the City of Moscow’ for personal merits:
moscow35-u40c66e6842c47e294d-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED PHYSICIAN OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-u15e38103403993a3a7-1.text: - in providing timely and highly qualified primary healthcare, applying modern advances in medical science and technology in practice;
moscow35-u15e38103403993a3a7-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED PHYSICIAN OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-uf3b8d1118f6ac89aca-1.text: - in introducing and applying new healthcare methods and improving existing ones, enabling reductions in morbidity and mortality and the provision of high-quality, timely medical care;
moscow35-uf3b8d1118f6ac89aca-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED PHYSICIAN OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-uaf0c4db2264f35bc7d-1.text: - in successfully combining highly professional clinical practice with effective organisational and scientific work in medicine.
moscow35-uaf0c4db2264f35bc7d-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED PHYSICIAN OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-u6878e667082cf30bc1-1.text: For the purposes of these Regulations, highly professional practising physicians means persons with the highest qualification category who have worked in medical organisations within the state healthcare system of the City of Moscow for at least 15 years.
moscow35-u6878e667082cf30bc1-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED PHYSICIAN OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-uf1020b9f237d715720-1.text: Persons awarded the honorary badge ‘Honoured Physician of the City of Moscow’ receive a cash award of 300000 roubles. The Department of Healthcare of the City of Moscow pays the cash award on the basis of the Mayor of Moscow’s decision to award the honorary badge ‘Honoured Physician of the City of Moscow’.
moscow35-uf1020b9f237d715720-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED PHYSICIAN OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-ufe2fdf207344844e96-1.text: The honorary badge ‘Honoured Physician of the City of Moscow’ is not awarded a second time to the same person.
moscow35-ufe2fdf207344844e96-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED PHYSICIAN OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-u3be00338b3db2bbf99-1.text: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
moscow35-u3be00338b3db2bbf99-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-u86d0598f20f29cfbb7-1.text: 1. The honorary badge ‘Honoured Industrialist of the City of Moscow’ is the highest form of recognition for merits in the industrial sector of the City of Moscow.
moscow35-u86d0598f20f29cfbb7-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-ude583b5874b1ea3f83-1.text: 2. The honorary badge ‘Honoured Industrialist of the City of Moscow’ is awarded to highly professional employees of entities operating in industry and other persons who have made a substantial contribution to the industrial development of the City of Moscow, for personal merits:
moscow35-ude583b5874b1ea3f83-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-uaef2c1829f14b0dc29-1.text: 2.1. Increasing the efficiency of the City of Moscow’s industry, the quality of its products and their consumer properties.
moscow35-uaef2c1829f14b0dc29-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-ua43cea74d408f0a2e5-1.text: 2.2. Successfully fulfilling production assignments, developing and introducing new types of products into production in the City of Moscow, and increasing the share of domestically produced products.
moscow35-ua43cea74d408f0a2e5-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-u3b6341f9ca29a357bf-1.text: 2.3. Carrying out scientific, rationalisation and innovative activities that increase labour productivity, environmental performance and energy efficiency of production, and promote the stable development of the City of Moscow’s industry.
moscow35-u3b6341f9ca29a357bf-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-ub78b837d53fc98527d-1.text: 2.4. Creating new production facilities, industrial sites and industrial infrastructure in the territory of the City of Moscow using modern high-technology equipment.
moscow35-ub78b837d53fc98527d-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-u6a3abcf4de11cfb371-1.text: 2.5. Training qualified personnel for the industry of the City of Moscow.
moscow35-u6a3abcf4de11cfb371-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-udc904f4d499287e1b0-1.text: 2.6. Enhancing the social importance of skilled trades, preserving continuity between generations and developing multigenerational occupational traditions within families.
moscow35-udc904f4d499287e1b0-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-u288ef0b04a64ad4e22-1.text: 2.7. Achieving other significant results in implementing the industrial policy of the City of Moscow and in professional activities.
moscow35-u288ef0b04a64ad4e22-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-ue50b2503f4b049f171-1.text: 3. For the purposes of these Regulations, highly professional employees of entities operating in industry means workers, engineering and technical personnel, researchers and heads of entities operating in the industrial sector of the City of Moscow who have received state awards of the Russian Federation or the USSR, departmental awards or awards of the City of Moscow, or hold honorary titles of the City of Moscow, or are winners of professional skills competitions, and who work in industry in the City of Moscow.
moscow35-ue50b2503f4b049f171-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-ube6c106aa7bde3f2ab-1.text: 4. Persons working in other fields in the City of Moscow may be awarded the honorary badge ‘Honoured Industrialist of the City of Moscow’ for outstanding merits and achievements contributing to the development of industry in the City of Moscow.
moscow35-ube6c106aa7bde3f2ab-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-u289f1ce5fb788de0e7-1.text: 5. Persons awarded the honorary badge ‘Honoured Industrialist of the City of Moscow’ receive a cash award of 300000 roubles. The Administrative Affairs Directorate of the Mayor and Government of Moscow pays the cash award on the basis of the Mayor of Moscow’s decision to award the honorary badge ‘Honoured Industrialist of the City of Moscow’.
moscow35-u289f1ce5fb788de0e7-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-u808cad5053cc7b8af7-1.text: 6. Up to 100 honorary badges ‘Honoured Industrialist of the City of Moscow’ are awarded annually.
moscow35-u808cad5053cc7b8af7-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’

moscow35-u236e163f554d8f4f37-1.text: 7. The honorary badge ‘Honoured Industrialist of the City of Moscow’ is not awarded a second time to the same person.
moscow35-u236e163f554d8f4f37-1.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY BADGE ‘HONOURED INDUSTRIALIST OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’
